body:
PR #2657 (BUG-2010) has been updated with all requested changes from STRICT round 1 and marked ready for review.

Head SHA: 2c31de5a8ca007a5e30f1bd6285be160072723dc

Changes addressed:
1. BLOCKING: Added explicit self_claim parameter to session_start. The launcher/spawn paths (agent new, session start --launch, worktree-gc) pass self_claim = false, so leases minted for another agent skip caller attribution and leave caller registry records untouched. Added test_agent_new_does_not_attribute_lease_to_calling_lane verifying caller lane A's current_spec and worktree_path remain untouched and lease X is not attributed to A.
2. REQUIRED: live_agent_for_lease_or_spec strictly requires the lease's own active_pid_start_time. If missing, the lease is treated as unattributed.
3. REQUIRED: Removed the 5s started_recently fallback from live_agent_for_lease_or_spec; matching requires active_pid == agent.pid and valid start-time liveness.
4. REQUIRED: test_drain_phase_child_and_claude_leases_preserve_predecessor_and_sigterm_invariants now mints the lease through session_start in an orchestrated context with a published, corroborated drain token, asserting active_pid is None and predecessor checks pass.
5. OPTIONAL: Logged update_agent_current_spec errors with warning on failure instead of silently dropping; removed unasserted smoke call.

Passed make check-ci-fast locally without warnings or failures.
subject: PR #2657 (BUG-2010) ready for review - round 1 addressed
